_doc: Text layout rules of the Latin dialog engine (US / EU / DE release); evidence and code addresses in docs/translation-analysis.md, section 3.  Cells are 8 px wide glyph slots; the cell index of a screen counts from 0 in the VRAM stream order of the dialog box (a line is 28 cells, the stream simply continues in the next line).  Used by tools/translate/check.py and the wrap layout of the translation source.
